summary: Standardize how SDKs handle Nexus Operation input argument deserialization failures. Currently different SDKs treat these failures inconsistently—some as retryable, others as non-retryable. The agreed standard: payload converter failures are non-retryable (BAD_REQUEST), codec failures are retryable (INTERNAL).
userImpact: Users experience inconsistent error handling behavior across different SDKs when Nexus Operation input deserialization fails.
rootCause: Different SDKs independently implemented deserialization failure handling without standardized treatment of retry semantics.
proposedFix: Standardize all SDKs to treat payload converter failures as non-retryable (BAD_REQUEST) and codec failures as retryable (INTERNAL). Create per-SDK implementation tickets.
resolutionDetails: Standardization agreement established and implemented across TypeScript, Python, .NET, Ruby, and Rust. Go and Java to be addressed via separate GA-specific solutions.
keyQuote: failures from the payload converter are non retry able (BAD_REQUEST), and failures in the codec are retry able (INTERNAL)
